req.title: Task title trimmed of whitespace
req.statement: The system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from the title on POST /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-037 requires that POST /tasks/ trims leading and trailing whitespace from the task title before persisting it. The test suite covers: (1) EP positive — a title with leading+trailing spaces is stored trimmed; (2) EP positive — a title with only internal spaces is NOT trimmed (only leading/trailing); (3) NEG negative — a title that is only whitespace becomes empty after trimming and should be rejected (4xx); (4) BVA boundary — a title padded with spaces to exactly max_length (100) after trimming is accepted; (5) BVA boundary — a title whose trimmed form exceeds max_length is rejected. Each test imports the app in-process, uses TestClient, and asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_task_trims_leading_and_trailing_whitespace
preconditions: Database is initialised with pre-loaded rows
actions: POST /tasks/ with title '   Buy milk   ' (leading and trailing spaces)
trace: R-TASK-037: system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from title
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_trims_leading_and_trailing_whitespace():
    payload = {"title": "   Buy milk   ", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Buy milk"

test_post_task_trims_leading_and_trailing_whitespace()

tests.name: test_post_task_title_trimmed_to_exactly_max_length_accepted
preconditions: Database is initialised with pre-loaded rows
actions: POST /tasks/ with title that is 100 'a' characters padded with 3 leading and 3 trailing spaces (total 106 chars raw)
expected: Response JSON field 'title' is exactly 100 'a' characters (trimmed to max boundary)
trace: R-TASK-037: trimming must happen before length validation; BVA at max_length=100 boundary
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_title_trimmed_to_exactly_max_length_accepted():
    core = "a" * 100
    padded = "   " + core + "   "
    assert len(padded) == 106
    payload = {"title": padded, "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == core
    assert len(body["title"]) == 100

test_post_task_title_trimmed_to_exactly_max_length_accepted()
